subject: 2026 Mission Statement and Strategic Goals
overview: The commission formally adopted a 2026 mission statement and strategic goals focused on infrastructure advocacy and public outreach. Key administrative actions included starting a search for new officers and requesting the mayor expand the body to 13 members.

items.title: Guest Introductions and Minutes
items.summary: Introduced guests from the city planning office and local advocacy groups before approving the May 2026 meeting minutes.

items.title: Adoption of Mission Statement and 2026 Goals
items.summary: Approved a formal mission statement and a list of strategic goals for the remainder of the calendar year after discussing the importance of time-bound targets.

items.title: Assignment of Goal Ownership
items.summary: Commissioners assigned individual 'champions' to lead specific objectives, including safety ordinance research, bike rack installations, and rotary repainting projects.

items.title: Commission Membership and Officer Nominations
items.summary: Approved a motion to request the mayor appoint additional members to reach a target of 13 and opened a nomination period for a new chair, vice chair, and secretary.

items.title: Farmer's Market Bike Fest and Summer Ride
items.summary: Approved participation in the July 30 Farmer's Market Bike Fest and a group ride to the Northern Strand bike kitchen scheduled for July 9.

items.title: Event Recaps: Bike to Work Day and Bike Bash
items.summary: Reviewed the successful turnout at the Medford Bike Bash and the youth bike swap, noting the importance of liability waivers and mechanical support from the BU bike kitchen.

items.title: Budget Update and Public Safety Supplies
items.summary: Discussed a budget increase for training and supplies, and agreed to coordinate with the administration to secure funding for a bulk order of youth helmets.

items.title: Infrastructure Issues and Legislation
items.summary: Addressed a hazardous parking meter placement in a Medford Square bike lane and reviewed pending state e-bike regulations.
